Plugin.Name: TR-004 SMART
Plugin.Overview: BETA. Shows SMART data (temperature, health, all attributes, identity, error log) of disks inside a QNAP TR-004 USB enclosure in the Unraid GUI, as if they were attached directly - and protects them while doing so.[br][br] The JMicron controller of the TR-004 only answers SMART requests through a "mailbox" sector on one of its disks. smartctl -d jmb39x uses sector 33 by default, which is part of the GPT - an aborted request destroys the partition table. This plugin uses a free sector in the gap before the first partition instead, backs up sectors 0-63 of every enclosure disk before each run, restores any change after every single command and blocks unsafe smartctl jmb39x calls system-wide.[br][br] Values are refreshed every minute. Self-tests can be started from the Unraid GUI. Settings: Settings - Utilities - TR-004 SMART (English/German).
